+title: 'AVK-8f ErrorView and CompactionEntryView: change the transcript entries from glass to the content surface'
+---
+## Why
+
+D110 (b). An error entry and a compaction entry are rows of the transcript (`Thread/ItemRow.swift` lines 147 and 149). The transcript is content, so these rows have no glass.
+
+## Files
+
+- `Sources/AgentViewKit/Items/ErrorView.swift` line 92: `.glassEffect(theme.materialLevel.glass, in: .rect(cornerRadius: theme.radii.l))`.
+- `Sources/AgentViewKit/Items/CompactionEntryView.swift` line 96: the same modifier.
+- `ErrorView` also shows in `Activity/ActivityTimeline.swift` line 293. That place is content too.
+
+## What to do
+
+- [ ] Replace `ErrorView.swift` line 92 with `agentContentSurface()` (AVK-8b).
+- [ ] Replace `CompactionEntryView.swift` line 96 with `agentContentSurface()`.
+- [ ] Keep the colors from `\.editorTheme` (`severityError`, `statusColor(for:)`).
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- `ErrorView.swift` and `CompactionEntryView.swift` have no `.glassEffect`.
+- A test renders each view over a backdrop of one unique color with `RenderedPixels`. No pixel of the backdrop color shows inside the entry.
+- All tests in `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Items/`, `Thread/` and `Activity/` pass.
+- Tests use Swift Testing. No clock, sleep, poll, retry, timeLimit or XCUITest. #avk-8
\ No newline at end of file
